import json

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter,deque
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # connected components (4-conn)
    cs=set(cells); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        q=deque([s]); comp=[]
        seen.add(s)
        while q:
            r,c=q.popleft(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if n in cs and n not in seen: seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    pattern=comps[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    pc_r=sum(r for r,c in pattern)/len(pattern)
    pc_c=sum(c for r,c in pattern)/len(pattern)
    # exact center of bounding box
    rs=[r for r,c in pattern]; cls=[c for r,c in pattern]
    cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; cc=(min(cls)+max(cls))//2
    for comp in comps[1:]:
        if len(comp)!=1: continue
        mr,mc=comp[0]
        for r,c in pattern:
            nr,nc=mr+(r-cr), mc+(c-cc)
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: out[nr][nc]=g[r][c]
    return out
